While speaking to supporters at a rally in Suffern, New York on Friday, President Trump explained how he came up with the term 'Dumocrat' -- a word play on 'Democrat' and 'dumb.' Trump tied the nickname directly to House Minority Leader Rep. Hakeem Jeffries (D-NY), calling him "a dumb guy."  "I said wait a minute, he's a Dum-o-crat!" Trump explained. 'You take the 'e' out, you don't use the 'b', a lot of people don't know 'dumb' has a 'b' in it, actually."  Trump was speaking at Rockland Community College alongside Rep. Mike Lawler (R-NY). Lawler is running for reelection in New York's 17th Congressional District, which is expected to be one of the most closely watched House races this November.
